name: 7-Zip
description: 7-Zip is a file archiver with high compression ratios that supports many archive formats. It is released under the LGPL.

name: A Note
description: Lightweight desktop sticky notes app with colored notes, fonts, alarms and docking to screen edges. Open source (GPL) with no ads or paid tiers.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the standalone project's own site could not be verified; official_url is the PortableApps entry (third party). PortableApps lists App License: Open Source (GPL) and release 4.2.4 (2013-01-05). URL note: original developer site is gone; PortableApps.com (co-publisher, GPL source linked) is the maintained distribution and serves as the primary download.

name: Apache OpenOffice
description: Full open-source office suite (Apache License 2.0) with Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base and Math. Actively released (4.1.16, Nov 2025) and free for any purpose including commercial use.
notes: Project strongly warns users to download only from the official site. Also listed in the Microsoft Store for selected languages; could not verify a stable store URL so no alt added.

name: BabelPad
description: Unicode text editor and word processor by Andrew West with full Unicode character support. Free for personal and commercial use, fully featured, single executable with no installer, no ads or in-app purchases.
notes: Author asks users to download only from babelstone.co.uk and does not support third-party distributions. Verified free for commercial use on the official page.

name: Blender
description: Blender is a 3D creation suite for modeling, animation, rendering and video editing. It is developed by the Blender Foundation and released under the GPL.

name: Cherrytree
description: Hierarchical note-taking app (GPLv3) storing rich text, images, tables, links and code snippets in a single file, with password protection. Actively maintained by Giuseppe Penone.
notes: UNCERTAIN: official site URL — sources cite both giuspen.net/cherrytree and giuspen.com/cherrytree; used the most recent citation (giuspen.net). GitHub repo giuspen/cherrytree confirms open source.

name: DSynchronize
description: DSynchronize is a folder synchronization tool from Dimio. It is freeware, free for personal and business use.

name: Duplicate Files Finder
description: Duplicate Files Finder from MindGems scans drives for duplicate files so they can be removed. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free tier fully finds and deletes duplicate files; the Pro version only adds fuzzy search and related extras.

name: Duplicati
description: Duplicati is an encrypted backup client that stores incremental backups on cloud storage and remote servers. It is released under the MIT license; the commercial Duplicati, Inc. sells managed services, not the client.

name: Everything
description: Everything is a file and folder search tool from voidtools that returns results as you type. It is freeware; donations are optional and all features work without paying.

name: Explorer++
description: Explorer++ is a tabbed, dual-pane file manager for Windows. It is released under GPL-3.0-only; version 1.4.0 is current.

name: FastCopy
description: FastCopy is a file copy and delete utility. It is freeware; personal use is free while some commercial use may require a paid license.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the current EULA on fastcopy.jp was not verified; pendriveapps reports personal-use-free with a paid license for some commercial use.

name: File Converter
description: File Converter adds file conversion and compression presets to the Windows Explorer context menu. It is a personal open source project released under the GPLv3.

name: FileOptimizer
description: FileOptimizer reduces file sizes without changing their formats and supports many file types. It is released under the AGPL-3.0.
notes: UNCERTAIN: portablefreeware.com reports an optional startup ad screen that can be disabled — could not verify it only promotes the developer's own support message.

name: FileVoyager
description: FileVoyager is a dual-pane file manager with tabs and a preview pane. It is freeware; version 25.12.5 is current.

name: Finance Explorer
description: Finance Explorer is a personal finance and budgeting application from Metalogic Software. It is freeware for personal and business use.
notes: Publisher site is offline; the PortableApps release page is used as the download source (PortableApps notes the package is made available directly from the publisher).

name: FocusWriter
description: Distraction-free full-screen text editor with hide-away controls, themes, daily writing goals and live statistics. Free and open source (GPL) by Graeme Gott, actively released (1.9.0, Feb 2026).
notes: Sources conflict slightly on GPL version (Wikipedia says GPL-2.0-or-later, LinuxLinks says GPLv3.0); repo is github.com/gottcode/focuswriter. URL scheme (https) assumed from the cited domain; could not verify exact canonical form.

name: FreeCAD
description: FreeCAD is a parametric 3D CAD modeler aimed at mechanical engineering and product design. It is released under the LGPL-2.1.

name: FreeCommander
description: FreeCommander is a dual-pane orthodox file manager with tabs and built-in viewers. It is freeware, free for personal and commercial use.

name: FreeFileSync
description: FreeFileSync is a folder comparison and synchronization tool. It is released under the GPLv3.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the official FAQ says the standard and Donation editions are personal-use-only (businesses need the Business Edition); third parties report occasional donation prompts, not verified as nagging.

name: FUPX
description: FUPX is a compressor frontend from gurupia based on UPX for shrinking executables. It is freeware; version 3.2 is current.

name: GnuCash
description: GnuCash is a double-entry accounting program for personal and small-business finances. It is released under the GPL.

name: HomeBank
description: HomeBank is a personal accounting application for managing accounts, budgets and reports. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: Inkscape
description: Inkscape is a vector graphics editor for illustrations, icons and diagrams. It is released under the GPL-2.0 or later.

name: Joplin
description: Free and open-source (AGPL) note-taking and to-do app with Markdown notes, end-to-end encrypted sync to a target of your choice, plugins and web clipper.
free_enough_reason: Paid Joplin Cloud sync service exists, but the app is complete offline-first software and syncs free to local folders, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV or a self-hosted Joplin Server.
notes: No account needed for core features; a Joplin Cloud account is only needed if using that optional paid sync service. Self-hosted Joplin Server is free for non-commercial use.

name: Kanri
description: Kanri is an offline kanban board application for organizing projects and to-dos. It is released under the GPL-3.0 and saw active development through 2026.

name: KiCad
description: KiCad is an electronic design automation suite for schematic capture and PCB layout. It is released under the GPL-3.0.

name: LibreCAD
description: LibreCAD is a 2D CAD application for technical drawings and plans. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: LibreOffice
description: Open-source (MPL-2.0) full office suite from The Document Foundation with Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base and Math. Actively released (26.8.1, Oct 2026) with no licensing fees and no vendor lock-in.
notes: Enterprise ecosystem editions with SLAs exist from third-party companies, but the community release itself is fully free with no paid tier, so free_enough is false.

name: Logseq
description: Privacy-first open-source (AGPL-3.0) personal knowledge base with graph view, Markdown and org-mode support and local-first data storage. Actively maintained by Logseq Inc.
free_enough_reason: A paid Logseq Sync service exists, but the app is a complete local-first knowledge base that stores notes as local Markdown or org-mode files and syncs fine without it.
notes: No account needed for core features; paid sync is optional.

name: Money Manager Ex
description: Money Manager Ex is a personal finance manager with budgeting, reporting and multi-currency support. It is released under the GPL.

name: NanaZip
description: NanaZip is a 7-Zip fork with a modern Windows interface, dark mode and MSIX packaging. Its own code is MIT licensed; the 7-Zip-derived code keeps the 7-Zip license. Actively developed; 7.0 released 2026.

name: Notes
description: Fast, private Qt-based note-taking app by nuttyartist with Markdown support, folders, tags, themes and a Markdown-to-Kanban board. Fully open source and cross-platform, tracks nothing.
free_enough_reason: A paid Pro license exists but only unlocks editing inside the Kanban view and a year of Pro updates; the free app is otherwise complete, and all Pro features are available free by building from source.
notes: Could not verify the exact OSI license identifier (README asserts fully open source); repo is github.com/nuttyartist/notes.

name: PeaZip
description: PeaZip is a file archiver and manager that supports many archive formats. It is released under the LGPLv3.

name: Pencil2D
description: Pencil2D is a hand-drawn 2D animation and drawing application. It is released under the GPL-2.0.

name: PNotes.NET
description: PNotes.NET is the .NET-based successor to PNotes, a desktop sticky-notes application. Its project page lists the GPLv2 as its license.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the standalone license file could not be located; the SourceForge project umbrella lists GPLv2. Last release 3.8.2.2 (Nov 2021).

name: PNotes
description: PNotes is a desktop sticky-notes application with scheduling and customization options. It is released under the GPLv2.

name: PortableApps.com AppCompactor
description: AppCompactor compresses application folders to reduce their disk footprint. It is open source; version 3.17 released 2026-06-29.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the exact PortableApps app-page URL was not captured verbatim, so the PortableApps.com domain root is used; version 3.17 released 2026-06-29 per PortableApps news.

name: Q-Dir
description: Q-Dir is a quad-pane file manager from SoftwareOK. It is freeware.

name: QOwnNotes
description: Plain-text Markdown note-taking app (GPL-2.0-only) storing notes as local files, with tags, scripting, optional AES-256 encryption and Nextcloud/ownCloud integration. Actively maintained by Patrizio Bekerle.
notes: Sync is handled externally (e.g. Nextcloud client); no account required for core features.

name: RedNotebook
description: Desktop journal and diary (GPL) with calendar navigation, tags, templates, spell check and export to plain text, HTML, LaTeX or PDF. Data stored in plain-text files. Actively released (2.43, Oct 2026).
notes: PortableApps lists an old RedNotebook Portable (1.15.0, 2017); current releases come from the official site, so no alt added.

name: Run-Command
description: Run-Command is a small run-dialog replacement from SoftwareOK. It is freeware; version 6.41 is current.

name: Scribus
description: Scribus is a desktop publishing application for page layout and print-ready documents. It is released under the GPL.

name: StackNotes
description: StackNotes is a desktop sticky-notes application distributed as open source. SourceForge lists it as Public Domain while PortableApps lists a FreeBSD license.

name: Stickies
description: Stickies is a lightweight sticky-notes application from Zhorn Software. It is freeware for personal and business use; version 10.2a released Jan 2025.

name: Syncthing
description: Syncthing is a continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between devices. It is released under the MPL-2.0.

name: Task Coach
description: Task Coach is a to-do manager with hierarchical tasks, effort tracking and reminders. It is released under the GPL-3.0 and remains actively developed.

name: Toucan
description: Toucan is a file synchronization, backup and encryption utility. It is released under the GPLv2 and maintained by PortableApps; version 3.1.8.2 is current.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the exact PortableApps app-page URL was not captured verbatim, so the PortableApps.com domain root is used.

name: TreeSize Free
description: TreeSize Free scans drives and folders to show disk space usage. It is freeware and the free edition is a complete product.
free_enough_reason: The free edition fully scans and reports disk usage; paid editions add export, scheduling and enterprise features.
notes: UNCERTAIN: JAM's own FAQ allows commercial use but a JAM marketing PDF says personal non-commercial only — conflict unresolved; personal_use set to false per the FAQ.

name: Virtual Volumes View
description: Virtual Volumes View catalogs offline media and archives so they can be searched later. It is released under the GPL; version 1.5 released Jan 2024.

name: WinDirStat
description: WinDirStat is a disk usage statistics viewer with a treemap display. It is released under the GPLv2; version 2.8.0 released Aug 2026.

name: WinFile
description: WinFile is the classic Windows File Manager, open-sourced by Microsoft. It is released under the MIT license.

name: Wise Duplicate Finder
description: Wise Duplicate Finder finds and removes duplicate files on a drive. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free version fully searches for and deletes duplicate files; only the automatic 'Keep One' option requires the Pro version.

name: Wise Force Deleter
description: Wise Force Deleter deletes files locked by other processes. It is completely free with no paid tier.

name: Wise JetSearch
description: Wise JetSearch is a file search tool from WiseCleaner. It is freeware.

name: WizFile
description: WizFile is a disk search utility from Antibody Software. It is freeware; personal use is free while commercial use requires a Supporter or Enterprise license.

name: WizTree
description: WizTree is a disk space analyzer that scans drives quickly. It is freeware, free for personal use only; commercial use requires a paid license.

name: Zettlr
description: Open-source (GPL-3.0) Markdown editor for researchers and note-takers with citation support, Zettelkasten knowledge management and exports via Pandoc and LaTeX.
notes: Donations requested on the site; all features work without donating.

name: Zim
description: Desktop personal wiki (GPL-2.0-or-later) keeping notes as plain-text wiki pages in a folder structure, with linking, plugins, task list and equation editor. Actively released (0.77.0, June 2026).
notes: URL scheme (https) assumed for zim-wiki.org; could not verify canonical scheme. Windows builds support 64-bit Windows 10 only.
